bullets: On Thursday 26 November, Dubai recorded 466 sales worth AED 1.4bn, which is 3.5% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 55.4% of the day's sales, compared to 58.3% over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,667 per sq ft, down 1.5% over 30 days and 0.7% from last year.
Over the last seven days, the busiest areas were JVC with 225 sales, Business Bay with 137, and Dubai South with 132.
In October new rental contracts for a 1-bedroom apartment in JVC had a median of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Dubai equities have erased geopolitical losses, showing strong investor confidence in our property and financial sectors.
Market discussions are actively addressing potential property correction risks and the regional growth outlook.
Dubai airport expansion contracts have now reached $21.8bn, driving real estate demand through infrastructure growth.
